Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
wrt Sire's Index Finger

is it just me, or would we have been better off doing either of the
following:

Have 'frenzy card' written on Rotschrek/Drawing Out the Beast, and
added as errata to others not printed in this set.

OR

Just have Sire's Index Finger not mention 'frenzy card' at all, and
just say this vampire is immune to [list of cards].

?

hmmm....weird to refer to attributes of cards, and not give those
cards that attribute in the same set it is printed in...

presumably the 'frenzy card' reference on Sire's Index Finger is in
case of future 'frenzy cards' being printed, but then why wouldn't the
current printing of existing frenzy cards mention frenzy card? is it
because they were in starters only and the reprints didn't get their
text updated at all?

salem
